cadence.measurement: Frames covered by resolved asynchronous GPU queue fences; max 2 outstanding. Notification timestamps are CPU delivery times, not individual GPU timestamps or display scanout.
cadence.targetDefinition: At least 30 confirmed GPU-completed frames in every whole second of a 120-second window. Notification gaps are reported separately; individual frame latency is not inferred from batched callbacks.
cadence.scope: Synthetic night-storm fixture, production settings, 120 seconds; every whole second >=30 GPU completions. Not live-weather or native-WKWebView evidence.

scrubClip.note: Actual full app: live WebGPU scene composited with rasterized live DOM, including weather glyph, light/rain/tide track and rolling values. One forecast hour per second, followed by four seconds of the real paywall. Synthetic clear → storm → clearing → night. Not an OS screen recording; backdrop blur can differ in DOM capture. Full UI held expanded for inspection. No FPS measurement during encoding.
